name: The Girl In White
source:
Long, a high school senior, uncovers the Dream Corridor – an endless hallway of doors between life and death. What starts as fascination quickly becomes horror when he realizes ghosts have always been among us… waiting.

[From [url=https://master2015hp.itch.io/the-girl-in-white]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
朗，一名高中生，发现了梦想走廊——一条连接生与死的无尽走廊。当他意识到鬼魂一直在我们中间……等待时，一开始的迷恋很快就变成了恐惧。

[来自[url=https://master2015hp.itch.io/the-girl-in-white]Itch.io[/url]]
